wait: Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
request_user_input: Request user input for one to three short questions and wait for the response.
exec: Run JavaScript code to orchestrate/compose tool calls.
apply_patch: The `apply_patch` tool can be used to edit files.
create_goal: Create a goal only when explicitly requested by the user or system/developer instructions; do not infer goals from ordinary tasks.
exec_command: Runs a command in a PTY, returning output or a session ID for ongoing interaction.
get_goal: Get the current goal for this thread, including status, budgets, token and elapsed-time usage, and remaining token budget.
list_mcp_resource_templates: Lists resource templates provided by MCP servers.
list_mcp_resources: Lists resources provided by MCP servers.
read_mcp_resource: Read a specific resource from an MCP server given the server name and resource URI.
request_plugin_install: Suggest a recommended plugin installation
update_goal: Update the existing goal.
view_image: View a local image file from the filesystem when visual inspection is needed.
write_stdin: Writes characters to an existing unified exec session and returns recent output.
web__run: Tool for accessing the internet.
spawn_agent: Spawns an agent to work on the specified task.
followup_task: Send a follow-up task to an existing non-root target agent and trigger a turn if it is idle.
interrupt_agent: Interrupt an agent's current turn, if any, and return its previous status.
list_agents: List live agents in the current root thread tree.
send_message: Send a message to an existing agent.
wait_agent: Wait for a mailbox update from any live agent, including queued messages and final-status notifications.
